gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p5 prints Transfers in (out) per column: General (34,000), Street 200,000, Sales Tax (100,000), Other Governmental Funds 34,000, Total 100,000 (net, from the component unit). Detail records the schedules gross: General Fund departments combining statement pp14-15 Administrative (491,689) and Police 228,744 + Fire 26,793 + Park 61,652 + Pool 52,500 + Library 88,000 = 457,689 (net (34,000) = statement General column); Street budget schedule p11 Transfer in 200,000; Sales Tax p12 Transfer out (100,000); nonmajor p13 Civic Center 16,000 + Sinking 18,000 = 34,000. Positive detail 457,689 + 200,000 + 34,000 = 691,689 vs statement net 100,000: the gap 591,689 is the gross departmental transfers inside the General Fund (457,689) plus the intra-governmental transfers (200,000 + 34,000) that the Total column nets; all detail amounts are printed and correctly signed. No fix.

No business-type schedule exists; the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position (p7) prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Trash Fund columns. JSON receipts = Consumer sales 4,241,019 + Other revenue 24,277 + Interest income 1,301 + Grants 120,617 = 4,387,214. Added per column: Electric 3,604,761 + 8,495 + 619 = 3,613,875; Water 395,769 + 14,052 + 584 + 120,617 = 531,022; Sewer 140,003 + 468 + 98 = 140,569; Trash 100,486 + 1,262 = 101,748. 0 + 4,387,214 = 4,387,214 (gap 0).
